lines.japanese: ある朝のこと。
lines.english: One morning...

lines.japanese: ちょっと早くに目が覚めてしまったので、俺は暇つぶしにウェブの海を泳いでいた。
lines.english: I woke up a little early, so I killed time swimming through the sea of the web.

lines.japanese: 俺の中のタカシ的な部分はこの種のインドア遊びが大好きだったし、鷲介的な部分は雑学の獲得に楽しみを見出していたし、隼人的な部分はインターネットの達人だった（なんだそりゃ）。
lines.english: The Takashi part of me loved this kind of indoor amusement, the Shuusuke part enjoyed picking up trivia, and the Hayato part was a master of the internet. (What does that even mean?)

lines.japanese: さーて、なんか面白くて為になる情報でもないかなぁ～。
lines.english: Now then, let’s see if there’s anything interesting and educational out there.

lines.japanese: 「なっ、なにィ！　男性の長髪は毛根への負担が大きく、抜け毛の原因になる（という説もある）だってぇー！」
lines.english: “Wh-what?! Long hair places greater strain on a man’s follicles and may cause hair loss—according to some theories?!”

lines.japanese: あわわ、これは大変だ。あとで親友の森里君に教えてあげよう。うふふ、さらに友情が深まること間違いなしだな。
lines.english: Oh, no. This was serious. I would have to tell my best friend Morisato later. Hee-hee. No question it would deepen our friendship even further.

lines.japanese: あっ、深まるといえば、小鳩との愛……あ、いや、家族的な意味でね！　家族の絆みたいのがね！　そう、それも深まっちゃうといいよね。
lines.english: Oh! Speaking of deepening things, what if my love with Kobato... I-I mean in the familial sense! Our family bond! Right, it would be nice if that deepened too.

lines.japanese: というわけで、俺は小鳩の喜びそうなネタを探しはじめた。
lines.english: And so I began looking for a tidbit Kobato might enjoy.

lines.japanese: 「おにーちゃーん、朝ごはんできてるよー」
lines.english: “Big Brother! Breakfast is ready!”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、ちょっと待ってー」
lines.english: “Okay! Be down in a minute!”

lines.japanese: 下からの呼びかけを制してしばらく粘った。
lines.english: I fended off her summons and kept at it for a while longer.

lines.japanese: しかし大した成果は得られなかった。
lines.english: Unfortunately, I found nothing worthwhile.

lines.japanese: 「──うん、分かった。今？　お兄ちゃんと朝ごはんたべてた」
lines.english: “Okay, I understand. Right now? I was having breakfast with Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: パソコンの電源を落として一階へ下りると、小鳩が電話に出ていた。彼女の声音と語調からして、相手は叔母さんだろう。
lines.english: I shut down the computer and went downstairs to find Kobato on the phone. From her voice and manner, I assumed she was speaking to our aunt.

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の横を通りすぎて、ひとり居間へ入る。食卓には綺麗に朝食が並んでいた。
lines.english: I walked past her into the living room by myself. Breakfast had been laid out beautifully on the table.

lines.japanese: 「うん、お母さんもね。じゃあ切るよ。はーい」
lines.english: “Okay. You too, Mom. I’m hanging up now. Bye.”

lines.japanese: 「ふー」
lines.english: “Whew.”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩ー、叔母さん何だって？」
lines.english: “Kobato, what did Auntie want?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、きょう帰りに、しょうが焼きのお肉買ってきてって」
lines.english: “She wants me to buy some pork for ginger stir-fry on the way home today.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ、ひとりじゃ大変だからお兄ちゃんに付きあってもらえだとっ！」
lines.english: “What?! She said that would be too much for you alone and you should have your brother come along?!”

lines.japanese: 「なぁ～んてな、ははは、お兄ちゃんちょっとハッスルが過ぎちゃったよ。夕食の買い物ぐらい、小鳩ひとりで行けるもんな」
lines.english: “Just kidding! Ha-ha-ha. Your brother got a little overexcited. You can handle the dinner shopping by yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「待て小鳩。そんな即答をしていいのか？　よーく考えてごらん。店の場所は分かるのか？　荷物はひとりで持てるのか？　人さらいのおじさんに声かけられたらどうするんだ？」
lines.english: “Wait, Kobato. Are you sure you want to answer that quickly? Think very carefully. Do you know where the store is? Can you carry everything alone? What if some kidnapper tries to talk to you?”

lines.japanese: 「だいじょぶだよ、何度も行ってるんだから」
lines.english: “I’ll be fine. I’ve been there lots of times.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかあ……そうだよね……お兄ちゃんの出る幕なんかないよね……」
lines.english: “Oh... Right... There’s no need for your brother...”

lines.japanese: 「うん。残念だけど」
lines.english: “Yeah. Too bad.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんといっしょにお買いものだったら楽しいけど、じゅけん生だからべんきょうでいそがしいもんね」
lines.english: “Shopping with you would be fun, but you’re busy studying for your entrance exams.”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　そうだ、今日は学校終わったら参考書を買いに行こうと思ってたんだ。あれえ、超奇遇～。せっかくだから一緒に行っちゃう～？」
lines.english: “Oh! That’s right! I was planning to buy some study guides after school today. Wow, what a coincidence! Since we’re both going, wanna go together?”

lines.japanese: 「ほんと？　いいの？」
lines.english: “Really? Is that okay?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、あああ当たり前じゃないか。べべべべつに俺、喜んでないよ」
lines.english: “O-of c-c-course. I-I-I’m not happy about it or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「私はうれしいなー。わあーい、ほうかご楽しみー」
lines.english: “I am! Yay! I can’t wait for after school!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、こここ小鳩は子供だなあ。俺は妹と出掛けるぐらいでそんな、はしゃいだりとか全然ないし、どどどどう見ても冷静だからね。超クールだし」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! K-K-Kobato, you’re such a child. I would never get excited just because I’m going out with my sister. I-I-I’m obviously perfectly calm. Cool as ice.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃっほーう！　ウヒャ、ウヒャッ、フゥ～……イェッヒィィー！」
lines.english: “Yee-haw! Ooh! Ooh! Whoo! Yee-hee!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が洗いもののため席を立ったあと、俺は庭へ飛びだして歓喜の叫びをあげていた。
lines.english: After Kobato left the table to do the dishes, I ran into the yard and gave a howl of joy.

lines.japanese: 「なーにー？　お兄ちゃん、朝から近所めいわくだよー」
lines.english: “What are you doing? You’re bothering the neighbors this early, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい」
lines.english: “Okay!”

lines.japanese: 咎められてしまったので、居間へ戻る。
lines.english: Chastened, I returned to the living room.
“Ahhh...”

lines.japanese: 羽田家は朝食後のリラックスタイム。
lines.english: It was time for the Haneda household to relax after breakfast.

lines.japanese: テレビには朝のニュースバラエティが流れているが、浮かれている俺の頭にはほとんど入ってこない。
lines.english: A morning news-and-variety show was playing on TV, but hardly any of it reached my giddy brain.

lines.japanese: いや、まあ、俺はシスコンとかロリコンとかそういう気が全然ないし、妹とデっ、デデデ、デートとかもべつに興味ないんだけど、叔母さんからのお願いじゃあなあ。仕方ないよなあ。
lines.english: It wasn’t as if I had a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything like that, and I wasn’t interested in going on a d-d-d-date with my sister. But our aunt had asked. What choice did I have?

lines.japanese: ああ、そうと決まれば、今から放課後が待ちどおしいなあ。
lines.english: Now that it was settled, I could hardly wait for school to end.

lines.japanese: フフフ、生姜焼きの肉などたちどころに選んでみせて、この兄がどれだけ頼りになるのかを教えてあげちゃうぜ。
lines.english: Heh-heh-heh. I would select the pork for ginger stir-fry in the blink of an eye and show her exactly how dependable her brother could be.

lines.japanese: だがあまりに素敵なお兄ちゃんぶりを披露すると、小鳩がうっかり恋愛感情を持ってしまうかもしれないからな。兄妹でそれはまずいだろうから、自重しなければ。もはははは。
lines.english: Although, if I proved too wonderful a brother, Kobato might accidentally develop romantic feelings for me. That would be rather inappropriate between siblings, so I would have to restrain myself. Mwah-ha-ha-ha.

lines.japanese: ええい、プリンセス・ダヴはそのような尻の軽い（尻は基本的に重いです）女ではないわ、ウッヴァアアアァン！
lines.english: Silence! Princess Dove is no loose woman! (Her rear is quite solid, thank you very much.) Uuuwwaaahhh!

lines.japanese: 「っととと、いかんいかん」
lines.english: “Whoa. No, no, no.”

lines.japanese: 最近は気を抜くと、すぐに奈落者が表に出てきてしまう。これは仮統合して以来、感情が昂ったときなどに見られる症状だ。
lines.english: Lately, the moment I let my guard down, a denizen of the abyss would come bursting to the surface. Ever since our provisional integration, this symptom had appeared whenever my emotions ran high.

lines.japanese: 俺は慌てて意識の安定化に努めた。油断していたら、せっかくの仮統合が解けてしまうかもしれない。
lines.english: I hurried to stabilize my consciousness. If I grew careless, our hard-won provisional integration might come undone.

lines.japanese: やっぱりあの日、きちんと自分に向かいあうべきだったかなあ。
lines.english: Maybe I should have faced myself properly that day after all.

lines.japanese: 故郷の街へ自分探しの旅に出るべきだったかなあ。
lines.english: Maybe I should have gone on a journey of self-discovery to the town where I grew up.

lines.japanese: でももう過ぎた話だもんなあ。自分と向きあうのとかめんどくさいしなあ。
lines.english: But that was all in the past now. Facing myself sounded like such a pain.

lines.japanese: 子供のころの嫌なこととか、一切思いだしたくないしなあ。おお恐い恐い。
lines.english: I didn’t want to remember a single bad thing from my childhood. Oh, how frightening.

lines.japanese: うん、やっぱり俺は、このままダルンダルンの俺でいいや……統合なんか上手くいかなくても何とかなるだろ……適当でいいよ、そんなのは……。
lines.english: Yes, I was happy staying this loose and sloppy... We would manage even if the integration never quite worked... None of that needed to be taken too seriously...

lines.japanese: 「どしたの、ぼーっとして」
lines.english: “What’s wrong? You’re staring into space.”

lines.japanese: げっ、まずい、気付けば小鳩がすぐ側にいるじゃないか。
lines.english: Oh, crap. While I wasn’t looking, Kobato had come right up beside me.

lines.japanese: 俺としたことが、まるで隼人君みたいな仏頂面……おう、誰が仏頂面だ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。あーもー、おまいらケンカすんなてー。
lines.english: Here I was, wearing a scowl just like Hayato—hey, who’re you calling a scowler? I’ll fucking kill you! Aw, come on, you guys, quit fighting.

lines.japanese: そう、ケンカしている場合じゃない。俺が不安定な状態だなんて知ったら小鳩が不安がるに違いない。
lines.english: Yes, this was no time to fight. If Kobato learned how unstable I was, she would be worried sick.

lines.japanese: 俺はとっさに話題を探した。なにかないか、なにか。
lines.english: I scrambled for something to talk about. Anything. Come on, anything.

lines.japanese: 「はっ、アレは！」
lines.english: “Wait! That!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩のかたわらの雑誌に目が留まった。彼女が毎月買っている少女漫画誌だ。
lines.english: A magazine beside Kobato caught my eye. It was the girls’ manga magazine she bought every month.

lines.japanese: 「え？　これ？」
lines.english: “Huh? This?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が雑誌を拾いあげる。
lines.english: Kobato picked it up.

lines.japanese: 「そう、それに昔っから連載してる有名な漫画があるだろう。何年か前にドラマ化もした、あたしの何たら言うやつ」
lines.english: “Yeah. There’s that famous manga that’s been running in it forever, right? The one they made into a drama a few years ago. Something about ‘my something.’”

lines.japanese: 「『あたしの涙よ誰かに届け』？」
lines.english: “*Let My Tears Reach Someone*?”

lines.japanese: それだ。うん、やっぱり知ってたな。
lines.english: That was it. Good. I knew she would know.

lines.japanese: フフフ、アンテナの高いお兄ちゃんは、さっきサプライズ間違いなしの情報をキャッチしてしまったのだ。
lines.english: Heh-heh-heh. Her brother’s finely tuned antenna had just picked up a piece of information guaranteed to surprise her.

lines.japanese: これは小鳩も驚くぞう。すごーい、お兄ちゃんなんでそんなこと知ってるのー！　いやいやハハハ、大したことありますよ。
lines.english: Kobato would be amazed. “Wow, Big Brother, how did you know that?” Oh, no, ha-ha-ha, it was quite a big deal indeed.

lines.japanese: 「聞いて驚けよう？　なんとその漫画！　来月で連載終了でえぇーっす！」
lines.english: “Prepare to be amazed! That manga is ending next month!”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: うふふ、驚いてる驚いてる。
lines.english: Hee-hee. She was shocked. She was shocked.

lines.japanese: そして次の瞬間には、すごーい何でも知ってるお兄ちゃん好き好き大好きぃー！　いやいやハハハ、大したこと──
lines.english: And in another instant she would cry, “Wow, Big Brother, you know everything! I love you, I love you, I love you!” Oh, no, ha-ha-ha, it was quite a—

lines.japanese: え、あれ？　あんまり喜んでないな。
lines.english: Huh? That was odd. She did not seem very pleased.

lines.japanese: 「なんで終わっちゃうの？」
lines.english: “Why does it have to end?”

lines.japanese: ていうか、あれ？　涙目？
lines.english: Wait. Were those tears in her eyes?

lines.japanese: 「なんでって、その、最近人気が急降下してるらしくて……」
lines.english: “Why? Well, apparently its popularity has fallen off a cliff lately...”

lines.japanese: ネットで見たんだけどね、ヒロインの相手役の五所川原先輩に全裸で安来節を躍らせた回が、ものすごく不評を買っちゃったんだって。
lines.english: I had read online that the chapter where the heroine’s love interest, Goshogawara, performed the Yasugi Dance stark naked had gone over terribly with readers.

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ……」
lines.english: “I see...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の顔は思ってたより深刻だった。
lines.english: Kobato looked far more stricken than I had expected.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、私の一番好きな漫画……」
lines.english: “That’s my favorite manga...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: そ、そうだったのか。この俺の情報網をもってしても、そこまでは掴めていなかった。
lines.english: S-so it was. Even my peerless intelligence network had failed to uncover that much.

lines.japanese: 「さいきん後ろのほうに来てるとは思ってたけど……ついに『あたとど』打ち切りなんだ……」
lines.english: “I knew it had been getting pushed toward the back lately... So *Tears Reach* really is being canceled...”

lines.japanese: あ、あああ。小鳩の顔がどんどん悲しそうになっていく……落ちこんだ小鳩もかわいいけど、それ以上に痛々しくて見てられない。
lines.english: Oh. Oh, no. Kobato looked sadder by the second... Even a dejected Kobato was adorable, but more than that, she looked so hurt I could hardly bear to see her.

lines.japanese: 小鳩は俺の使用済み食器を手に取ろうとしたが、だらんと両腕を落としてうなだれてしまった。
lines.english: Kobato reached for my used dishes, then let both arms fall limp and hung her head.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……お兄ちゃんの食器あらうの、帰ってきてからでいいかな……水に浸けといてくれればいいから……」
lines.english: “Sorry... Can I wash your dishes after I get home? Just leave them soaking for me...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、いいんだ。自分の使ったものぐらい自分でやるさ。ははは、お兄ちゃん頼りになるだろう？」
lines.english: “O-of course. I can wash what I used myself. Ha-ha-ha! Your brother is dependable, isn’t he?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ありがとう……もう今日は何もやる気がおきない……」
lines.english: “Yeah. Thanks... I don’t feel like doing anything today...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ……じゃ、じゃあ、放課後のデ……お買い物は？」
lines.english: “What...? Th-then what about our d—our shopping after school?”

lines.japanese: 「あ……うん、ごめんなさい。ちょっと今日はすぐ帰りたいから、ひとりで行ってくる。じゃあ……」
lines.english: “Oh... I’m sorry. I just want to come straight home today, so I’ll go by myself. Bye...”

lines.japanese: ぬえええええええええええっ！？
lines.english: Nnnggghhhhhhh?!

lines.japanese: 小鳩との約束がなくなったという衝撃は、俺という自我をいとも容易く崩壊させた。
lines.english: The shock of losing my plans with Kobato effortlessly shattered the ego known as me.

lines.japanese: だだ、だって、こばっ、こば、こヴァああアーっ！
lines.english: B-b-b-but, Koba—Koba—Kobwwaaahhh!

lines.japanese: ゴヴァアアア──！　ウヴァアアアアア──！
lines.english: Gwwaaahhh! Uuuw waaahhh!

lines.japanese: へべらっしゃあああああァァああぁぁぁ……！！
lines.english: Hblarrrghhhhaaaaaaahhh...!!

lines.japanese: そして俺たちはふたたびバラバラになってしまった。
lines.english: And so we fell apart once again.

lines.japanese: どうしてこんなことに……いや、原因は分かってるじゃん。小鳩さんとのお出かけがなくなっちゃったからだよね。
lines.english: How did this happen...? No, the cause was obvious. Our outing with Kobato had been canceled.

lines.japanese: いや、そんなことは問題ではない！　俺個人の感情よりも、小鳩が悲しそうな顔をしていたことが問題だ！　プリンセス・ダヴの微笑みは私が守る！
lines.english: No! That is beside the point! Kobato’s unhappy face matters far more than my personal feelings! I shall protect Princess Dove’s smile!

lines.japanese: あーもーなんかおまえら混ざってんぞー。
lines.english: Aw, hell. You guys are blending together now.

lines.japanese: ……とりあえず、だ。「誰が」悲しませたじゃなくて「何が」悲しいのかが重要なんじゃねえか？
lines.english: ...Anyway. The important question isn’t “who” made her sad. It’s “what” she’s sad about, right?

lines.japanese: 俺たちの中の誰かが言った。
lines.english: One of us had spoken.

lines.japanese: そうそう。その悲しみを取りのぞいて小鳩さんを喜ばせてあげることが、いま優先されるべきことなんじゃないかなあ。
lines.english: Exactly. Our first priority should be to take away that sadness and make Kobato happy again.

lines.japanese: その意見には、俺たち全員が賛同した。
lines.english: All of us agreed.

lines.japanese: うん、そうだね。僕たち兄弟で言いあらそってても誰も喜ばないよ。小鳩を笑わせてあげよう。
lines.english: Yeah. We’re brothers—arguing with each other won’t make anyone happy. Let’s make Kobato smile.

lines.japanese: 俺たちに異論はなかった。だが俺たちの誰かが疑問に思った。
lines.english: There were no objections. But then one of us raised a question.

lines.japanese: で、その方法は？
lines.english: How?

lines.japanese: ふむ。まずは原因を突きとめよう。
lines.english: Hmm. First, we identify the cause.

lines.japanese: 小鳩はお気に入りの漫画が終わることにひどく胸を痛めている。
lines.english: Kobato is deeply upset because her favorite manga is ending.

lines.japanese: それなら俺たちで打ち切りを阻止しよう！
lines.english: Then we will stop it from being canceled!

lines.japanese: いや、もちろん、一介の学生でしかない俺たちにそんな力はないわけだが──
lines.english: Of course, we were only ordinary students and possessed no such power—

lines.japanese: ──まあ、この際、結果は置いといてだ。とりあえず俺たちに出来るだけのことをしよう。
lines.english: —yet results were beside the point. For now, we would do everything within our power.

lines.japanese: お兄ちゃんたちは小鳩の味方だ、小鳩にはたくさんの味方がいるんだ、っていうことだけでも彼女に伝わればいいんじゃないかな。
lines.english: If nothing else, we could show her that her brothers were on her side—that she had a great many people on her side.

lines.japanese: よし、それじゃあ俺たちの人脈を駆使して、署名運動でも始めるか。
lines.english: All right. We’ll put our connections to work and start a petition.

lines.japanese: おー、それいいじゃん。ぜってーポッポもよろこぶってー。おお、そんじゃそれでいこうぜ。
lines.english: Oh, man, that’s a great idea. Poppo’ll love it for sure. Yeah, let’s do it.

lines.japanese: 守るべきプリンセスのため、俺たちは珍しく団結した。
lines.english: For the sake of the princess we had to protect, we achieved a rare moment of unity.
